platform_constraints: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with Tailwind CDN — no React/Next.js build pipeline
Static file server (server.js) with Node http module — no SSR framework
API via /api/orders (Upstash Redis) — no auth middleware currently
Browser-only: sessionStorage/localStorage for persistence — no server-side sessions
Existing emoji-heavy UI: 60+ emoji instances across 4 HTML files + 1 JS file

proven_sources.name: chenlee86/keepurl
proven_sources.why_proven: Clean sessionStorage-based auth gate: prompt password → sessionStorage.setItem('auth','true') → check on load. Directly adaptable for seller portal modal auth.

proven_sources.name: odysseus-dev/odysseus
proven_sources.why_proven: Self-contained login.html with inline SVG favicon, clean form layout, no framework deps. Proven pattern for standalone HTML auth page.

proven_sources.name: HumanSignal/label-studio
proven_sources.why_proven: Production login form with email+password fields, clean input styling, CSRF handling pattern. Adaptable modal structure.

proven_sources.name: Phosphor Icons
proven_sources.why_proven: 6000+ clean line/duotone SVG icons. Perfect replacement for all food/UX emojis. Inline SVG compatible, weight variants (thin/light/regular/bold/fill/duotone).

proven_sources.name: Lucide Icons
proven_sources.why_proven: Feather-icon successor. Clean 24x24 SVG line icons for search, bell, cart, check, clock, tag, shield, user, lock. Fork-friendly, zero deps.

design_reference_description: Meat/Market mobile & web app style: crisp white cards with rounded-3xl, high-contrast bold typography for prices, weight/portion chips as rounded-full pills, zero emojis — pure clean SVG line/duotone icons for search, notification bell, shopping cart, checkmark, clock, tag, shield. Minimal shadows (shadow-xs), clean 1px borders (border-gray-100), generous whitespace.
